subject: Web Development
title: Web Standards to the Rescue
description: A short lesson to help you apply Web Standards to the Rescue.

hook.text: While IE stagnated, a small group of idealists fought for a standards-based web.

buildup.text: The Web Standards Project pressured both browser makers and developers to follow W3C rules.

discovery.text: Jeffrey Zeldman's 'Designing with Web Standards' became the bible for modern web development.

twist.text: Standards compliance was mocked as impractical until Firefox proved it could also be fast.

climax.text: The standards movement laid the foundation for every modern browser to render pages the same.

punchline.text: Idealists built the web we use today.

quiz.question: What group pushed for web standards adoption?
